instruction: Rename the three mountain pictures in my Pictures directory to numbered format: mountain_1.jpg, mountain_2.jpg, and mountain_3.jpg in alphabetical order of their original names.

result.command: python3 -c "import os; import json; pics_dir = '/home/user/Pictures'; mountain_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(pics_dir) if f.startswith('mountain_') and f.endswith('.jpg')]); original_files = [f for f in os.listdir(pics_dir) if f.startswith('picture') and f.endswith('.jpg')]; result = {'mountain_files': mountain_files, 'original_exist': len(original_files) > 0}; print(json.dumps(result))"
